svg.desc: Undirected links. A crossing is not a connection unless a node is drawn.
svg.text: Undirected links. A crossing is not a connection unless a node is drawn.
Dashed links wrap; every node has degree four.
Hypercube: one bit changes per edge
Eight nodes, twelve links, diameter three.
Four local rings share one upper-level ring.
